title: Observability
html:
Pillars of observability (Logs, Metrics, Traces), Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, and SLA/SLO/SLI error budgets.

Three Pillars of Observability

Structured Logging

JSON formatted log events enriched with context (trace_id, user_id). Aggregated via Fluentd/Logstash into Elasticsearch/Loki.

Metrics

Numeric time-series data.
• Counter: Monotonically increasing (e.g., total requests).
• Gauge: Instantaneous value (e.g., memory usage).
• Histogram: Samples observations into buckets (e.g., latency P99).

Distributed Tracing

Tracks request lifecycle across microservice boundaries. Uses Trace ID, Span ID, and W3C Trace Context headers.

OpenTelemetry (OTel) Ecosystem

OpenTelemetry (OTel): Vendor-neutral CNCF framework providing unified APIs, SDKs, and the OTel Collector (Receiver → Processor → Exporter pipeline) to collect and route telemetry data to Prometheus, Jaeger, Datadog, or Grafana.

SLA, SLO, SLI & Error Budgets

SLI (Service Level Indicator)Quantifiable metric (e.g., Successful Requests / Total Requests)
SLO (Service Level Objective)Target reliability goal (e.g., 99.99% success rate)
SLA (Service Level Agreement)Legal contract with financial penalty (e.g., 99.9%)
Monthly Downtime at 99.99%4.38 Minutes / Month
